observations.unit: DPRK troops deployed to Russia during 2024
DPRK troops engaged in Kursk combat as of March 2025

observations.measurement: DPRK acknowledged troop deployment under treaty and combat in Kursk
Multilateral Sanctions Monitoring Team reported combat deployment and assessed Russia-provided military training against UNSC sanctions

limitations: Troops deployed in 2024 predate treaty entry into force on December 4; do not attribute the start of deployment to treaty activation.
DIA figures are estimates and 8,000 combat participants are a subset of roughly 12,000 deployed, not an additional force.
Casualties are a cost estimate, not a benefit or geopolitical influence measure.
DPRK and Russia confirmation is participant acknowledgment; DIA and MSMT supply external corroboration but not an independent causal counterfactual.
June 2025 MSMT report month is approximate metadata; use the PDF itself for report-date precision.
Do not infer sanctions compliance, strategic gains, or military effectiveness from troop counts alone.
